Tests batch bytes extraction with per-input config (extract_batch)

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract_batch([{ 'bytes' => 'pdf/fake_memo.pdf', 'config' => { 'output_format' => 'markdown' }, 'filename' => 'fake_memo.pdf', 'kind' => 'bytes' }])
puts result.results[0].mime_type.inspect
puts result.results[0].content.inspect
puts result.results[0].metadata.output_format.inspect
```
